description: Immutable implementation of a JSON Web Key (JWK) class, modeling cryptographic key information with methods for creation from parameters or JSON.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonWebKey
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the JsonWebKey interface representing a JSON Web Key with its cryptographic parameters.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a JsonWebKey instance from explicit parameters such as type, algorithm, usage, id, modulus, and exponent.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a JsonWebKey from a JSON string representing the key.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a JsonWebKey from a JsonObject representing the key.

methods.name: getAlgorithm
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the algorithm, if specified.

methods.name: getUsage
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the usage, if specified.

methods.name: getModulus
methods.description: Returns the modulus as a BigInteger.

methods.name: getExponent
methods.description: Returns the exponent as a BigInteger.
